subject: WCAG AA failure: --fd-text-3 on fd-card — fix value included
body:
Ran WCAG 2.1 AA audit on all new --fd-* tokens. One failure.

FAILURE
--fd-text-3: #6E7681 on --fd-card #161b22 = 3.77:1. FAIL (need 4.5:1 normal text).
Also fails on --fd-bg #0d1117: 4.12:1. FAIL.

WHERE IT IS USED (all at 0.73-0.85rem)
.tc-date — test card date
.tc-attempt — '1st attempt' label under score
.tc-norib — 'No run it back yet' text
.trend-hd-r — 'Target: A (93%+)'
.bn-sub — bottom nav subtitles
.slabel — section labels ('Your Progress', 'Last 2 Tests')
.trend-empty — empty chart state text

FIX
Replace --fd-text-3: #6E7681 with #7E8895.
Ratios: 4.81:1 on fd-card, 5.27:1 on fd-bg. Both PASS AA.
Hue is identical (blue-gray). Luminance bump only — visually consistent.

All other fd-* tokens pass:
fd-text-1 #E6EDF3 on fd-card: 14.64 PASS
fd-text-2 #8B949E on fd-card: 5.62 PASS
fd-green #3FB950 on fd-card: 6.81 PASS

You own this token. Your call on the exact fix value. #7E8895 is my recommendation.
If you approve, GA can patch it in index.html :root block or I can propose migration to shared/styles.css.
